name: Repeat Complaints Post-Remediation
description: Flag entities receiving >=2 new complaints within 60 days after last resolved complaint.

name: Channel Concentration
description: Flag any channel with >=8 complaints in a rolling 90-day window.

name: Product Concentration Spike
description: Flag any product with >=5 open complaints in a rolling 30-day window.

name: A3-C1 Mis-selling cluster (Motor Insurance)
description: Detects 4 or more Mis-selling complaints about Motor Insurance for the same entity within a rolling 30-day window.
